title: [CQ-RF04] Windows Restart Daemon supervisor race
description:
Objective: on Windows, Restart Daemon must leave no old supervisor that can respawn its `_run` child. Today Process.destroy is TerminateProcess, which kills only the supervisor and orphans `_run`. An old supervisor can then respawn `_run` after the restart. This is CQ-R01 follow-up 4.

Created by architect-e4b7eee0 on 2026-10-30, when the human moved the non-gating R01 follow-ups out of CQ-R13. It edits MoeDaemonSupervisor.kt after CQ-RF03.

Deliverable: the Windows restart path in MoeDaemonSupervisor.kt.
- Stop through the installed daemon CLI's `stop` first, so the supervisor exits without respawning.
- Then terminate the old supervisor's whole process tree (ProcessHandle descendants).
- Confirm that no old `_run` remains before starting the new daemon. Otherwise refuse with a fixed message.
- Other platforms are unchanged.
- Tests in MoeDaemonSupervisorTest use injected process handles.

Out of scope:
- CQ-RF01, RF02 and RF03;
- VS Code;
- .moe edits.

Verification command (fresh, exit 0 required): cmd.exe /d /c "cd /d D:\projexts\moes\moe-jetbrains && .\gradlew.bat test --rerun"
definitionOfDone: On Windows, Restart Daemon stops the old supervisor and every descendant before starting a new one, and no old `_run` survives to respawn. Shown by tests with injected process handles.
Restart behavior on Linux and macOS is unchanged. Shown by tests.
The verification command exits 0 with its output supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
